text:
Laura Chen: heads up — opened docs PR (#482) to refresh the Go quickstart for the newer client. Main changes: env var auth snippet, Dockerfile base image bump, and a short note clarifying REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_TOKEN. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-482

Kevin O'Neil: checking now. can you paste the exact auth snippet you used?

Laura Chen: Sure — used this:

```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}"
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

Samir Patel: we prefer `REDWOOD_TOKEN` for consistency with other languages. also the Dockerfile should use `FROM golang:1.21-alpine` (not 1.20) — CI failed in my run.

Kevin O'Neil: agree on token naming. tiny wording nit: change 'set your token' -> 'set your API token' in the quickstart sentence.

Laura Chen: ok will update. Samir — can you paste the failing log? I saw a `go mod tidy` error earlier.

Samir Patel: paste from CI:

```
# github.com/redwood/hello
../../go/pkg/mod/...: unexpected EOF
```

Samir Patel: looked like a `go.sum` mismatch; I bumped deps on the PR branch and re-ran `go mod tidy`.

Laura Chen: perfect — I'll update the env var name + Dockerfile + wording. Also fixing two broken links flagged by linkchecker: `auth.md#local` -> `/guides/auth#local-dev`.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-482/preview — checks: linkchecker ✅, lint: ⚠️ (one heading level needs demotion).

Kevin O'Neil: lgtm after laura's edits. also add a one-line migration note: 'If you upgrade from SDK v3, replace `NewClient(apiKey)` with `NewClientWithOptions(...)`' and include a tiny snippet showing parameters.

Laura Chen: added migration snippet and pushed another commit. Will squash the dependency bump and fix the heading level, then merge. Thanks for the quick reviews!

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:

Kevin O'Neil: :shipit:
